evidence_required: Five distinguishing properties, each with an ORION number.

marking.criterion: Five distinct properties named (coupling, bandwidth per server, traffic pattern, power density, failure semantics, or goodput economics)
Each property carries a correct ORION number (for example 17.4 s step, 3.2 Tb/s backend, about 41 kW per rack, 48 h job MTBF)
The contrast with a conventional cloud fleet is stated for each property

title: Five properties of an AI training cluster
